amendments.name: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Second (Amendment) Rules, 2025
amendments.summary: All pan masala packs, regardless of size/weight (including <=10g packs previously exempted under Rule 26(a) proviso), must print the Retail Sale Price (RSP) and all other LMPC 2011 declarations.

grades.A: All mandatory fields present and valid (0 violations, high confidence).
grades.B: Minor/non-mandatory issues or moderate confidence; no critical violation.
grades.C: One or more mandatory fields missing/wrong (critical violation).

product_category.label: Product Category (for category-specific rules, e.g. pan masala)

rules.message: Maximum retail price must be printed on the label.
rules.guidance: Look for 'MRP ₹' / 'Rs.' inclusive of all taxes.

rules.message: MRP must be declared as inclusive of all taxes.
rules.guidance: The label should state MRP is 'inclusive of all taxes'.

rules.statute: LMPC Rules, 2011 — Rule 6 (declarations must be printed; sticker MRP is restricted)
rules.message: MRP appears to be affixed as a separate sticker rather than printed.
rules.guidance: Separate MRP stickers are not permitted except in allowed cases; verify print vs sticker.

rules.message: Net quantity (with correct unit) must be declared.
rules.guidance: e.g. 'Net Weight: 500 g', 'Net Qty: 1 L', '20 x 50 g'.

rules.statute: LMPC Rules, 2011 — Rule 6 & Seventh Schedule (standard units)
rules.message: Net quantity must use a standard prescribed unit.
rules.guidance: Weight in g/kg, volume in ml/L, length in m/cm, or count (N/pcs).

rules.message: Month and year of manufacture/packing must be declared.
rules.guidance: e.g. 'Mfg: 03/2026' or 'Manufactured: Mar 2026'.

rules.statute: FSSAI Labelling & Display Regulations / LMPC Rule 6
rules.message: Product is past its expiry / best-before / use-by date.
rules.guidance: Check date formatting (MM/YYYY or DD/MM/YYYY); expired goods are unsafe.

rules.message: Expiry / use-by / best-before date must be declared.
rules.guidance: Look for 'Use before', 'Best before', 'EXP'.

rules.message: Name and address of manufacturer/packer/importer must be declared.
rules.guidance: Manufacturer/packer/brand owner with full address (Rule 10).

rules.message: Customer-care number or email must be printed.
rules.guidance: Toll-free/phone or email for consumer grievances.

rules.message: Customer-care phone number looks invalid.
rules.guidance: Indian mobile (10-digit starting 6-9) or a helpline like 14404.

rules.message: Customer-care email looks invalid.
rules.guidance: Should be a valid email address.

rules.message: FSSAI logo is missing on the food label.
rules.guidance: Look for the FSSAI mark with the licence number.

rules.message: FSSAI licence number is missing.
rules.guidance: Usually printed near the FSSAI logo.

rules.message: FSSAI licence number must be exactly 14 digits.
rules.guidance: Format is 14 digits (often shown as 1XXXXXXXXXXXXX). A malformed/short number is non-compliant.

rules.message: Vegetarian/non-vegetarian symbol (green/brown mark in square) is missing.
rules.guidance: Green triangle-in-square = veg; brown = non-veg.

rules.message: Ingredients list is missing.
rules.guidance: Must list ingredients (often 'Ingredients: ...').

rules.message: Common/generic name of the commodity is missing.
rules.guidance: The product must not show only a brand name; the generic name is required.

rules.statute: LMPC Rules, 2011 — Fourth Schedule (minimum numeral height)
rules.message: MRP/net-quantity numerals may be smaller than the Fourth Schedule minimum.
rules.guidance: Minimum numeral height depends on packet size (e.g. larger packs require taller figures).

rules.statute: LMPC Second (Amendment) Rules, 2025 — GSR 881(E), effective 01-Feb-2026 (pan masala)
rules.message: All pan masala packs (every size, incl. <=10g) must print the Retail Sale Price (RSP) from 1 Feb 2026.
rules.guidance: The small-pack (<=10g) declaration exemption was withdrawn for pan masala; RSP must be printed, even on tiny pouches.

rules.statute: LMPC Second (Amendment) Rules, 2025 — GSR 881(E), effective 01-Feb-2026 (pan masala)
rules.message: Pan masala packs must display ALL mandatory declarations (net quantity etc.), regardless of size.
rules.guidance: Under the 2025 amendment pan masala is no longer exempt from the full declaration set even for small packs.
